description: Scan MCP servers for potential threats & security findings.

written.description: Judges an MCP server's tool definitions three ways, by YARA rule, by hosted inspection API and by asking a model, so a poisoned tool description has to clear more than one kind of reader.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(yara): bind only/must gaps in $execution_overrides to clause boundaries (rebase) (#276)

Rebase onto upstream main after #244 merged: the branch's earlier
commits (wildcard-gap bounding, negated-disclosure scoping) were
superseded by #244's merged evolution and are dropped here. What
remains is the issue #252 fix: bind the only/must alternatives of
$execution_overrides to clause boundaries ([^.\\n.;]) so a
restriction in one clause cannot reach "this tool" in another,
plus the 12 issue #252 regression tests. The #244 test coverage
(export-file fixtures and tests) is preserved untouched.

Signed-off-by: Varshith Puli <pulivarshit@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Harish <hsanthan@cisco.com>
